summaries.R1-L1: Over-invoicing can be used to move extra money to the seller, disguised as payment for goods. The officer could ask the customer to explain the exceptionally high price per item for these goods.
summaries.R2-L1: An implausible quantity-value relationship can indicate misrepresentation of the goods' true worth, potentially to move funds. The officer could ask the customer to clarify how four pieces of clothing could be valued so highly.
summaries.R5-L2: Shipping goods between countries where prices are similar, especially at a higher price, might suggest the transaction is not primarily for commercial gain. The officer could ask the customer to explain the commercial rationale for this shipment given the price and route.
